items.title: Square-cropped reference
items.role: The square crop the pipeline started from (step 1: square crop), kept unmodified for provenance and for re-entering a later phase.
items.typical_use: Not shipped in the engine PBR set; source of truth for histogram match (step 4) and for re-running the pipeline.

items.title: Seamless base tile
items.role: The tileable base color image itself, after border trim, histogram match, periodic decomposition, luminance flatten and min-cut seam finding.
items.typical_use: The tile that gets placed and repeated; the source every other map in the set is derived from.

items.title: Base color / albedo
items.role: Same pixel content as the seamless tile, named for an engine's base-color / albedo material slot.
items.typical_use: Diffuse/albedo input in a PBR material.

items.title: Normal map
items.role: Tangent-space surface-detail map derived from the height map's wrap-around gradient.
items.typical_use: Surface micro-geometry (bumps, grain, mortar lines) without added polygon count.

items.title: Roughness map
items.role: Local high-frequency contrast, inverted and clamped, derived from the same luminance signal as the height map.
items.typical_use: Micro-surface roughness input in a PBR material; busier detail reads as rougher.

items.title: Height / displacement map
items.role: Band-pass luminance signal (fine minus coarse blur), percentile-normalized to 0-1.
items.typical_use: Parallax/displacement input, and the source the normal map's gradient is computed from.
